capability: Read committed capability-record lifecycle and immutable post-final history with bounded read-only Git process fan-out while preserving the canonical validator and ADR 0061 merge semantics
searchEvidence: scripts/validate_repository.py::_historical_final_records is the sole capability-record history owner. A real-head probe returned 98 record histories but started 298 Git processes: one log, 98 rev-list, and 199 show invocations.
A two-record active-to-final fixture starts seven Git processes and supplies a deterministic red regression based on subprocess count rather than wall-clock timing.

scripts/v0916_parity_certification.py::PinnedGitReader proves the repository already uses strict git cat-file batch framing, but its parity-specific snapshot, size, and error authority must not be imported into the governance validator. This change reuses only that proven protocol pattern inside the existing validator owner.

A read-only prototype matched the current ordered histories and nested-path result for all 98 records. Of 200 requested revision:path objects, 30 are missing, so missing/deletion skip semantics must remain explicit.

After the lifecycle scan was reduced to two Git processes, the exact staged structure gate still timed out at 600 seconds. The remaining immutable-history owner audits 69 finalized records over an aggregate 4,945 later commits; one unchanged representative starts 164 Git processes in 7.06 seconds, proving repeated per-record commit inspection is the remaining fan-out.

A proposed path-filtered rev-list shortcut was rejected because Git history simplification can omit a merge whose complete tree equals the audited revision while a non-contained parent changes the exact path. The existing per-parent diff-tree -m, rename parser, and ADR 0061 containment classification must remain authoritative.
tests/scripts/test_agent_governance.py is the existing non-governed evidence owner for capability-record lifecycle, history, merge, deletion, and fail-closed validator behavior.
semanticOwner: scripts/validate_repository.py remains the sole capability lifecycle and immutable post-final history authority through _historical_final_records, _record_changed_in_commits_after, the existing per-parent diff parser, and ADR 0061 containment classifier
terminalContract: Replace per-path rev-list and per-revision show process fan-out with one fixed-argv reverse history inventory and one private, strictly framed, read-only git cat-file --batch stream. Preserve sorted candidate paths; oldest-to-newest lifecycle observation; direct-parent and .json filtering; nested-path reporting; invalid UTF-8, invalid JSON, wrong-schema, unrelated-state and missing-object skip behavior; first_active, latest_unfinalized_active, first_final and admitted-field-violation semantics; and stopping after the first final-complete record. Inventory or batch process failure, malformed headers, non-blob objects, invalid lengths, truncation, missing terminators, or trailing bytes fail closed. Within one validate_capability_reuse_governance invocation only, share exact results for immutable commit identities so each existing fixed-argv diff-tree -m --find-renames parse and ADR 0061 containment lookup executes at most once per commit. The cache is private, in-memory, invocation-local, never persisted or module-global, stores and replays exact errors as fail-closed results, and neither filters revisions by path nor changes ancestry, per-parent diff, rename, mutation-and-restore, redundant containment, non-contained parent, equal-tree, octopus, or inspection-error semantics. Deterministic tests must combine full semantic assertions with bounded process/unique-lookup counts and no wall-clock threshold. No persistent or cross-invocation cache, database, checkout read, write path, second validator, timeout increase, path-history shortcut, firmware, package, workflow, release, or authority change is admitted.

designReview.evidence: Independent R2 review first confirmed that ADR 0054's canonical lifecycle authority remains in validate_repository.py and approved one fixed-argv reverse inventory plus one privately framed read-only cat-file batch stream. After the exact structure gate exposed a second fan-out, review rejected path-limited rev-list because Git history simplification can omit a merge whose tree equals the audited revision while another non-contained parent changes the exact path, violating ADR 0061. The incorporated minimum preserves the existing ancestry, diff-tree -m --find-renames, parser, and containment owners while sharing only invocation-local immutable commit and merge results, with deterministic one-lookup-per-identity regressions and no persistent cache, timeout increase, second validator, working-tree read, or governance-semantic change.

finalReview.evidence: Independent exact-head semantic and evidence review of 40cf3be5..37057e5f found P0-P3 = 0 and scoped Polytail PASS for the capability-history batching. The implementation retains full ancestry, per-parent diff-tree -m rename and ADR 0061 containment semantics, strictly framed fail-closed cat-file reads, lifecycle and missing-object behavior, and invocation-local exact-result/error replay only. Focused lifecycle, merge, failure-cache, and lookup-count regressions passed; no persistent cache, path-history shortcut, second verifier, working-tree semantic read, firmware, package, or release authority was introduced.
